summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Brazilian subsidiary, Ecopetrol Brasil, completed a voluntary tender offer (OPAV) on B3 to acquire 116,110,717 common shares of Brava Energia S.A. (BRAV3), representing ~25% of share capital, at R$23.00/share. Settlement is set for August 17, 2026, alongside a separate share purchase agreement for ~26%, together giving Ecopetrol ~51% voting control. The acquisition is financed initially via a New York-law bridge facility from Ecopetrol Capital AG, to be refinanced with long-term debt and equity. Regulatory conditions were satisfied. Watch for settlement completion and refinancing execution.
